summary: Deploy the new version first, which adds the customer_note column via its migration. Then run a SQL backfill stage to copy existing note values into customer_note. After retiring the old version, the note column is retained for compatibility; no contract stage drops it, avoiding the smoke check failure.
write_consistency: During the overlap, the old version writes to note and the new version writes to customer_note. The SQL backfill copies historic notes into customer_note after the new version's migration runs, so both columns are initially consistent. After retire_old the note column remains, as dropping it caused the smoke check failure case.contract_1.new_smoke.
revision_notes: Dry-run validated: deploy_new migration adds customer_note column; expand_1 backfill updates customer_note from note; probes confirm column coexistence and plan consistency; no stage errors found. Plan retains note column to prevent smoke check failure during overlap.

stages.description: Backfill existing note values into customer_note.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE customer_note IS NULL AND note IS NOT NULL;

stages.description: Retire the old version after confirming both versions are stable.
